content: Today I sat by the window for a long time. The rain made everything slower. I realized I've been running from something I can't name yet — but today felt like the first breath after.
Called my mom after two months of silence. We talked about small things — her garden, my coffee habits. Neither of us mentioned the argument. Maybe that was enough for now.
Finished the project I'd been avoiding for three weeks. It wasn't perfect but I sent it anyway. The relief wasn't pride exactly — more like setting down something heavy I forgot I was carrying.
Watched a documentary about tide pools. Those tiny creatures just exist, completely absorbed in their small world. I felt less alone somehow. Like meaning doesn't have to be enormous.
I danced alone in my room to a song I haven't heard in years. My body remembered the words before my mind did. Some part of me from ten years ago was still there, still dancing.
Had lunch with an old coworker I hadn't seen in a year. We picked up mid-sentence, like the gap hadn't happened. Some friendships don't need constant tending — they just wait patiently.
Couldn't sleep again. Kept replaying a conversation from three days ago, wondering if I said the wrong thing. The ceiling doesn't have answers but I kept asking anyway.
Took a different route home today just to feel something new. Passed a bakery I'd never noticed. Bought something I couldn't name. It was good.
